basic_info.description: The Metropolitan is an established, luxurious residential community in the heart of San francisco's Financial District. This unique condo has magnificent city, water and bridge views! Features 2BR / 2BA, open living/dining floor plan with a gourmet kitchen that includes Viking stainless steel appliances and a private balcony. Marble master & guest bathroom, walk-in closet, washer/dryer in unit and 1-car parking. Second parking spot can be added with monthly fee. Building Amenities include 24 Hour Doorman,
